purpose.line: Show me the life I want and my money can afford, today and tomorrow, and get me there by the path of least resistance.

slides.title: yeslyf in one sentence
lines: Show me the life I want and my money can afford, today and tomorrow, and get me there by the path of least resistance.
For 23 to 38 year olds in Indian metros.
Designed for the curious middle, not the eager, and never for us.
slides.say: Working line. If you cannot repeat it back at the end, this meeting failed.

slides.title: Aarav, in four beats
lines: Sees two versions of his future in four minutes, on his own numbers. Pays.
Twenty-five minutes of numbers, most of them a tap.
Reads his plan: what success looks like, what is in the way, in order.
Does the first action in the app. Comes back next quarter; the plan has kept itself current.
slides.say: This is the whole product. Everything else is a branch of this.

slides.title: Purpose, core actions, cycle
lines: Core actions: build the plan once; do the next action; keep it current.
Cycle: build in week one; two or three actions in month one; a quarterly heartbeat; an annual reconfirmation.
It is fine to be ignored for six weeks. The quarterly return has to feel like an event.
slides.say: We measure actions done and quarterly reviews opened. Not daily opens.

slides.title: Three moments; everything else is plumbing
lines: Hero: R09 the reveal; G03 the first read of the plan; the first verified action done (E06 into H01c).
Plumbing on purpose: OTP, eSign, pay, data entry, execution rails. Fast, quiet, never clever.
slides.say: Design budget goes to three screens. The rest is speed.

slides.title: The golden path in nine frames
slides.say: This is the only path we walk today. The other 182 screens are branches of it.

slides.title: What does not move
lines: Decided: two SKUs, one app. Calls are config; no adviser is named. DIFM is invisible. No assumptions in client data: a band or explicit none, never a default.
Regulated: RIA agreement and eSign before advice. AA consent wording. Advertising code on projections. The declaration. DPDP notice before personal data.
slides.say: Design freedom is everything outside these two lists.

slides.title: The design principle: path of least resistance
lines: One question per screen. Bands before exact numbers. Quick ranges to clear the gate.
AA is the default lane; manual is the main road and never penalised.
Silent autosave, no exit modal, endowed progress.
One next action on Home. Execution in the app where rails exist. The review runs itself.
slides.say: Every screen you design gets one test: is this the least effort route to the next action?

slides.title: Scope lens
lines: 21 templates, 191 screens, three dropped.
25 returning-user states are backend config, not screens. 11 home variants are one screen plus a hero card.
Must, should, later tags follow this week.
slides.say: Quote by template. Instances are cheap; templates are the cost.

slides.title: What we are asking of you
lines: Visual design by template, hero templates first: T-chart for R09, T-card-stack for G03, T-hub for H01.
A vertical slice before anything else: R01 to R09 to P01, and G03, on a phone, with real engine maths. Done means one person outside the team completes it.
Analytics events are part of each screen's definition of done.
Quote the shell once. Alternative journeys and proposals are instances of existing templates, priced as variants.
Comments on the pages, with your name. Not in email.
slides.say: These five are the contract for how we work, before the quote.

slides.title: What is still moving, and dates
lines: Nine proposals and two alternative pre-paywall journeys, under a five-user test this month, before visual design starts.
Only the pre-paywall screens and a handful of plan and home screens move; the shell does not.
Pilot January 2027. Launch 1 February 2027.
What a user should say after onboarding: It shows me what my money can say yes to and tells me the next thing to do.
slides.say: If you hear us say a different sentence next month, hold us to this one.
